title: [CuTe] Keep K-slices distinct in TiledMMA::get_layoutC_TV (#3612)
body:
## Motivation

#3612: for a TiledMMA whose thread layout has a K mode (`ThrK > 1`), `TiledMMA::get_layoutC_TV()` is not well defined. Threads that differ only in their K coordinate (K-slices) hold partial accumulators of the same C elements, so their C coordinates need to stay distinct. On current `main`, how the K-slices are placed depends on the configuration:

| configuration | K-slice `k` on `main` |
|---|---|
| `ThrN > 1`, permutation does not extend N | its own copy of the tile (shift = `M*N`) |
| permutation extends N beyond `atom_N * ThrN`, e.g. `SM80_16x8x16`, thr `(2,2,2)`, `Tile<_32,_32,_16>` | shifted by `tile_M * atom_N * ThrN` < `M*N`, so **it partially overlaps slice 0** (512 of 1024 indices) |
| `ThrN == 1`, e.g. `SM80_16x8x16`, thr `(2,1,2)` | shift 0, so it **fully aliases slice 0** |

`get_layoutC_TV()` is also the input of `make_tiled_copy_C` / `make_tiled_copy_C_atom`.

## Root cause

`thrfrg_C` produces the thread mode `(ThrV,(ThrM,ThrN))`, which has no K mode. `get_layoutC_TV()` composes it with `thridx_2_thrid`, which maps `thr_idx` to a linear `(ThrV,ThrM,ThrN,ThrK)` index. For K-slices that index runs past the thread mode's domain, and the layout extends along ThrN's stride. That stride is `tile_M * atom_N` when `ThrN > 1` and 0 when `ThrN == 1`, so the offset of slice `k` is an accident of the ThrN mode rather than a defined position.

## Modifications

- `include/cute/atom/mma_atom.hpp`: give ThrK its own mode, with stride `size(ref_C)`, before composing with `thridx_2_thrid`. K-slice `k` maps to its own copy of the `(M,N)` tile at offset `k * M * N`, so `get_layoutC_TV()` is a bijection onto `[0, M * N * ThrK)`. For `ThrK == 1` the extra mode has size 1 and nothing changes (see below). `partition_C()`, `get_layoutA_TV()` and `get_layoutB_TV()` are unchanged.
- New `test/unit/cute/core/tiled_mma.cpp` (host-only, in `cutlass_test_unit_cute_core`), for every thread and value:
  - C: `get_layoutC_TV()(t,v)` == offset of `partition_C(t)(v)` + `k * M * N`, and every index in `[0, M*N*ThrK)` is hit exactly once.
  - A/B: `get_layout{A,B}_TV()` match `partition_{A,B}()`.
  - Configurations: UniversalFMA and `SM80_16x8x16`, `ThrK` = 1/2/4, K-fastest thread order, `ThrN == 1`, and permutations that extend M, N or K.

## Testing

**The new contract** (host, g++ 13): 26 TiledMMA configurations (UniversalFMA, SM70 8x8x4, SM75 16x8x8, SM80 16x8x16 / tf32 / f64, SM90 GMMA 64x128x16; `ThrK` 1/2/4; permutations extending M, N or K).

| | configurations meeting the contract |
|---|---|
| `main` | 16 / 26 (fails the 6 N-extended and the 4 `ThrN == 1` cases) |
| this PR | **26 / 26** |

The new unit test fails on `main` (11365 failed expectations) and passes with this PR.

**No change for `ThrK == 1`,** which covers all in-tree uses:
- *Layouts:* I dumped the full mappings of `get_layoutC_TV()`, `make_tiled_copy_C(...)` and `make_tiled_copy_C_atom(...)` (S/D TV layouts and tiler) with and without this change, for 14 configurations: UniversalFMA, SM70/SM75/SM80 atoms with and without permutations, and SM90 GMMA 64x128x16 with 1 and 2 warpgroups, paired with UniversalCopy and `SM90_U32x{2,4}_STSM_N`. All 221,615 mapped values are **byte-identical**.
- *SASS:* I compiled four translation units twice, with only `mma_atom.hpp` differing (`sm_80`, `sm_90a`, `sm_100a`, CUDA 12.8), and compared `cuobjdump -sass`. The dependency files confirm that each build used its own header. The SASS is **identical**:

  | translation unit | uses | kernels | SASS instructions |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `sm90_gemm_f16_f16_f16_tensor_op_f32_cluster_warpspecialized_pingpong.cu` | SM90 TMA epilogue, `make_tiled_copy_C` | 84 | 80,016 = 80,016 |
  | `examples/50_hopper_gemm_with_epilogue_swizzle.cu` | SM70/80 vectorized `collective::Epilogue`, `make_tiled_copy_C` | 18 | 18,368 = 18,368 |
  | `test/unit/cute/ampere/cooperative_gemm.cu` | `cooperative_gemm`, `make_tiled_copy_C` | 96 | 61,384 = 61,384 |
  | `sm80_gemm_f16_f16_f32_tensor_op_f32.cu` | SM80 3.x mainloop with `DefaultEpilogue` | 12 | 27,344 = 27,344 |

  These cover every in-tree caller of `make_tiled_copy_C` / `make_tiled_copy_C_atom` (`sm90_epilogue_tma_warpspecialized.hpp`, `sm70_epilogue_vectorized.hpp`, `cooperative_gemm.hpp`). The `_array` epilogue variants use the same calls.
- `make_tiled_copy_C` / `make_tiled_copy_C_atom` still compile for `ThrK > 1` TiledMMAs.

**Unit tests with this change** (H200):

| target | result |
|---|---|
| `cutlass_test_unit_cute_core` (includes the new `tiled_mma.cpp`) | 53 passed |
| `cutlass_test_unit_cute_layout` | 4 passed |
| `cutlass_test_unit_cute_ampere` | 228 passed |
| `cutlass_test_unit_cute_ampere_tiled_cp_async` | 4 passed |
| `cutlass_test_unit_cute_hopper_cooperative_gemm` | 1 passed |

Closes #3612
